fact: ANSSI, under the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and the Digital Economy, held a workshop to validate the draft State Information Systems Security Policy (PSSIE), attended by public institution representatives, cybersecurity experts and digital-sector actors, who analysed, enriched and validated its components.

fact: The Cite des sciences et de l'innovation, under the higher education ministry, held the DounIA conference on 30 April 2025 in Conakry with researchers, technology firm heads, innovators and students to co-build a national digital data and AI strategy, closed by the Prime Minister.
